Welcome to the Nemours KidsHealth® (KidsHealth.org) YouTube Channel. Nemours Children's Health is committed to transforming the health of all kids. We aim to give families the tools and confidence to make the best health choices. On our channel you'll find doctor-reviewed videos on hundreds of physical, emotional, and behavioral topics. We hope you find stories and advice that inspires you and helps you to stay healthy and happy. Please share our content with your friends and family.

KidsHealth® was founded in 1995 and continues to be the most-viewed site for children's health information written for the whole family — parents, kids, and teens. KidsHealth content is created by the experts at Nemours Children’s, including more than 300 Nemours clinicians who serve as medical reviewers. For more information, visit KidsHealth.org.
